page.content:
Doom of the gods: Fenrir, the serpent, Surtr, and the world's drowning.

How Ragnarok connects

  • Character: Fenrir — Fenrir breaks free and swallows Odin at Ragnarok.
  • Work: Poetic Edda — Voluspa in the Poetic Edda prophesies Ragnarok.
  • Character: Surtr — Surtr fires the world at Ragnarok.
  • Character: Thor — Thor kills the serpent and dies of its venom at Ragnarok.
  • Character: Odin — Odin falls to Fenrir in the last battle.
  • Event: Death of Baldur — Baldur's death darkens the age that ends at Ragnarok.

What is Ragnarok?

Ragnarok is the foretold collapse — Fimbulwinter, the unbinding of Loki and Fenrir, the deaths of Odin, Thor, Freyr, Heimdall, and Loki, and a green earth that rises afterward.

Key threads lead to Fenrir, Poetic Edda, Surtr, Thor, Odin and Death of Baldur.
